integrity: Proof supplies a three-contact optimality certificate and an independent feasible construction; numerical checks are corroborative.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric discrete-time kernels on C_n^2 for even n >= 8; unrestricted optimizer uniqueness not established; possible equivalent unindexed literature; finite floating-point corroboration is not an infinite proof.
title: Exact fastest mixing and a two-class holding-law transition on even squared cycles
